note: the page's drawTile run frame by frame on one main-slider tube (fast on from t 0, page time t from 0, strike time T = t + off, bubble clock 1.75 t): every burst in order. Each burst: t (page time of the contact), i (lane), rise (the lane's rise index), x, y, r, a (the bubble then), rot, n, k (strike index; -1 = the frame's own drawn-line test), src (event | spark | frame). Frames: regular = t_n = n / 60, n = 0 .. dur * 60; irregular = t advances by the dt list cyclically from 0. The C# run must draw at exactly these frame times.
